name: Dwella
description: Welcome to Dwella, [https://rafi-a12.netlify.app/] a modern real estate platform that connects buyers, agents, and admins seamlessly. Built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js), Dwella offers a feature-rich experience, including property listings, wishlist management, secure authentication, and integrated payments. 🚀
